app.title: Ferret
app.tagline: Raise one pet with someone you care about.
stage.unsupported: This browser cannot show the 3D ferret. Please update your browser or try another one.
stage.failed: The ferret could not load. Check your connection and reload the page.
name.title: Name your ferret
name.label: Name
name.error.too_long: That name is too long. Use 16 characters or fewer.
name.error.edge_space: A name cannot start or end with a space.
name.error.control_chars: That name has characters that cannot be used.
intro.title: Meet {name}
intro.curiosity.high: Very curious, it sniffs into everything.
intro.curiosity.mid: Curious about new things now and then.
intro.affection.mid: Friendly when it feels like it.
intro.affection.low: Independent, does things its own way.
hint.feed: Tap Feed to give {name} a meal.
hint.water: Tap Water to fill the water bowl.
hint.play: Tap Play, then drag the toy for {name} to chase.
hint.sleep: Tap Sleep to put {name} to bed.
hint.pet: Tap {name}, or press and hold, to pet it.
hint.room: Tap the floor to call {name}. Tap the ball to throw it. Tap the window to look outside.
play.instructions: Drag the toy. Keep it still and {name} will catch it!
play.noReward: No extra treat this time, {name} played recently.
welcome.title: Welcome back!
welcome.mood.needy: {name} would love something to eat or drink.
menu.title: Menu
menu.exportDone: Backup saved. Keep the file somewhere safe.
menu.importConfirm: Replace {name} with the pet in this backup?
menu.saveFailed: Could not save. Export a backup to be safe.
menu.credits: Credits: ferret model "Black Footed Ferret" by LandyStudio (sketchfab.com), CC BY 4.0, changed by us: rigged, animated, and repainted. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0
import.error.not_json: That file is not a backup.
import.error.wrong_format: That file is not a Ferret backup.
import.error.bad_checksum: That backup file is damaged or was edited.
import.error.too_new: That backup is from a newer version. Please update first.
import.error.migration_failed: That backup could not be upgraded.
import.error.invalid: That backup has data that cannot be used.
recovery.corruptTitle: We could not read the saved pet
recovery.corruptBody: Nothing was deleted. If you have a backup file, import it to bring your pet back.
recovery.tooNewBody: Your saved pet was made with a newer version. Reload the page to get the latest one.
about.title: About {name}
about.note: These numbers stay on your device. They are only sent if you choose to send feedback.
feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.prompt: What do you think? What would make you open the game again tomorrow?
feedback.label: Your message
feedback.copied: Copied. Paste it in a message to us.
feedback.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
feedback.privacy: Only your message, the counts from the About screen, and the app version are included. Nothing is sent unless you press a button.
error.copied: Copied. Please send it to us.
ios.notice: Add this page to your Home Screen, and export a backup. Safari can delete saved data after about a week.
dev.title: Developer tools
dev.clockLocked: Moving the clock forward only works in a preview (open ?pet=test&dev=1). On a real save it would leave the saved time ahead of real time. Use Pretend I was away instead.
dev.awayNote: Moves the pet's remembered times back, saves, and reloads so you see the welcome-back summary.
dev.behavior: Make the pet do this now
dev.corruptConfirm: This damages your saved pet on purpose. Export a backup first. Continue?
dev.corruptDone: Damaged. Reload the page to see what happens.
